note: Read by hand from the Meta Ad Library (UK, active ads) in Justin's browser. Facts and our own notes only: no competitor image, video or body copy is stored here. Days live is a clue an ad pays, never proof. proven is 90 days or more, probable 30 or more, under that too early (ad studio phase 1).
